kypExtensions.summary: Reading the Y as a modular chassis (recognition module upstairs, effector module downstairs, flexible joint between) that explains isotype-switching logic (constant swap preserves binding), isotype-dependent complement fixation, assay design (anti-Fab vs anti-Fc secondaries), and therapeutic antibody engineering; plus the disease map of the five steps (RAG null = SCID, TdT = restricted diversity, AID = hyper-IgM type 2) and the booster-kinetics payoff.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source presents anatomy and steps as lists without the chassis framing or the step-to-disease map. NOTE: papain/pepsin cleavage products are NOT on this printed page (verified absent from the p124 text layer) and appear only as a labeled bridge in pattern 2; the disease-genetics specifics of the distractors are standard immunology knowledge, cited only as KYP extension.
